vendor: Sunstone Circuits (ASC Sunstone, American Standard Circuits); assembly partner Screaming Circuits
location_s: Mulino, OR (fab); Canby, OR (assembly, Screaming Circuits)

shipping_us-ao.days: not published (allow up to 5 additional days in holiday/weather periods)

shipping_us-ao.unit: business days (2-day grace period in holiday/weather periods)
shipping_us-ao.cost: extra, calculated from UPS/FedEx rates by size/weight/destination

shipping_us-ao.unit: business days, 'arrives with your daily UPS/Fedex delivery Monday - Friday'

shipping_us-ao.method: UPS (Screaming Circuits assembled boards; customer may give own carrier/account)

cutoff_note: Fab: 4:00 pm PT for all orders; 1-day 4-6 L and 2-day >6 L need confirmation by noon PT (https://www.sunstone.com/pcb-manufacturing-capabilities/order-cut-off-times). Shipping changes by 9:00am PST on ship date. Assembly: materials by noon (https://www.screamingcircuits.com/faq).
barrel_plating_source-s: Sunstone: "*Plating Target is minimum of 0.0008" in the hole with approximately 0.001" - 0.0014" on the surface." https://www.sunstone.com/pcb-manufacturing-capabilities/layer-stackup, read 2026-10-15
outer_split_note-s: "1 Oz Selection (1 oz internal layers with 0.5 oz copper foil external layers)"; 4-layer 0.062 construction sheet: "Layer 1 .5 oz foil plated to approximate* thickness 0.0017"". https://www.sunstone.com/pcb-manufacturing-capabilities/layer-stackup, read 2026-10-15
laminate_df_note-s: no Df and no laminate brand: "FR-4 150 Tg", "FR-4 170 Tg"; "Dielectric constant for material (core and prepreg) is 4.5 (+/- 0.10)". https://www.sunstone.com/pcb-manufacturing-capabilities/layer-stackup, read 2026-10-15
process_s: Sunstone 'Custom' column of the detailed-capabilities page (Inner Layers / Outer Layers / Soldermask / Silkscreen / Drill / Other Capabilities tabs), built in Mulino OR through the custom quoting form, not the online order
quote_source-s: Quickturn page: 'Need controlled impedance, blind/buried vias, gold fingers, or a custom stack-up? Those features are available through ASC Sunstone's standard custom quoting form.' (https://www.sunstone.com/pcb-products/quickturn-pcbs). Standard PCBs page, 'Quoting tiers': 'our custom quote process can take up to 24 hours depending on complexity of the project.' (https://www.sunstone.com/pcb-products/standard-pcbs). The detailed page's online tier ('Online NRE') stops at 0.004"/0.004" at 1 oz; the 0.003"/0.003" here is the Custom column only. Quote form: https://onequote.sunstone.com/onequote-form/. Read 2026-10-23
times_note: No turn is published for the Custom tier; the quote (up to 24 h) sets it. The online tiers' turns (1 day limited review 1-14 L, 2 day NRE 1-20 L) are on sunstone_circuits.json and do not apply here.
min_trace_source-s: Detailed capabilities, Inner Layers tab, 'Minimum trace/space INNER', Custom, 1 oz Cu: '0.003" / 0.003"' (2 oz: 0.004"/0.004"); Outer Layers tab, Custom, 1 oz finished: '0.003" / 0.003"' (2 oz 0.004", 3 oz 0.006"). 'Material Type, Copper weight and PCB design may limit trace and space capabilities.'
min_drill_source-s: Drill tab, Custom: 'Smallest drill <0.008"' (no figure). The smallest figure Sunstone prints for a mechanical drill is the ASC PWB Capabilities tab, 'Min. drilled hole diameter', Standard Production: '0.006" 152 um' (Advanced or Prototype: '<.006"'). Used here as the floor; confirm on the quote
via_pad_source-s: Outer Layers tab, Custom: 'Via Pads 0.010" larger than finished hole size' -> 0.1524 + 0.254 = 0.4064 mm (ring 0.127 mm). Inner Layers tab, Custom: 'Pads for Vias 0.016" larger than finished hole size' -> 0.1524 + 0.4064 = 0.5588 mm on inner layers. The 'via + 0.006"' pad the 2026-10-14 read took from the old main page is no longer published
min_via_in_pad_drill_source-s: ASC PWB Capabilities tab, Hole Plugging: 'Copper filled vias | Hole sizes from .004" - .010" Aspect Ratio 1:1 Max' -> 0.1016 mm, a blind (microvia-depth) hole; a plugged through via needs 0.010" (non-conductive) / 0.015" (conductive) finished. UHDI page: 'Copper-filled microvia for VIPPO 3-4 mil diameter, aspect ratio <= 1:1'
solder_mask_source-s: Soldermask tab, Custom: 'Minimum Web <0.003"' (0.0762 mm used as the floor), mask clearance 'We will adjust'; ASC PWB Capabilities tab, 'Min. soldermask clearance', Advanced or Prototype: '0.0015" (per side) 37 um (per side)'
edge_source-s: Outer Layers tab, Custom: 'Minimum backset (distance from copper to board edge) 0.010"'
layers_note-s: Inner Layers tab: '1-14 Layers Yes', '15-20 Layers Yes', '>20 Layers Yes' for Custom; max_layers 20 is the largest published standard construction (L20-125-1oz1oz) on the layer-stackup page
impedance_source-s: Other Capabilities tab, 'Controlled Impedance' Custom: Yes. Controlled-impedance page: 'Impedance tolerance | +/-5% (verified by TDR coupon testing)' (https://www.sunstone.com/capabilities/controlled-impedance)
aspect_ratio_note-s: Inner Layers tab, Custom: '>10:1' (no maximum); ASC PWB Capabilities tab, 'Max. Aspect Ratio' 10:1 standard / 15:1 advanced. 10 kept as the floor
microvia_source-s: UHDI CAPABILITIES tab: 'Microvia hole diameter 75 (Rigid: 50 um thick material or less)', 'Microvia pad diameter 200', 'Copper Thickness in Microvia 25 nominal Or Copper Filled', 'Copper Via Fill Yes'; Blind & Buried Vias page (https://www.sunstone.com/capabilities/blind-and-buried-vias): blind and buried both built, 'Via depth-to-diameter ratio should generally not exceed 8.1'; Standard PCBs page: 'Blind and buried vias | Supported'
via_in_pad_standard_source-s: Within this quoted tier: Standard PCBs page 'Via fill | Conductive and non-conductive fill available'; ASC PWB Capabilities tab 'Copper filled vias: Hole sizes from .004" - .010" Aspect Ratio 1:1 Max', conductive plugging min. finished hole 0.015", non-conductive 0.010"; UHDI tab 'Via-inPad-Plated-Over (VIPPO) Yes'. The online tiers do not offer it (quickturn page: 'Via fill | Not available'), which is why sunstone_circuits.json says false. Read 2026-10-23

hdi-o.note: UHDI (semi-additive) process, its own quote: UHDI PCBs page 'Minimum line width 20 microns (0.8 mil) current', 'Microvia diameter Down to 75 microns with copper fill', 'Copper-filled microvia for VIPPO 3-4 mil diameter, aspect ratio <= 1:1', impedance <5 %; detailed page UHDI tab line width 15 / space 12.5 um, through hole 150 um / pad 300 um. https://www.sunstone.com/pcb-products/uhdi-pcbs

not_published_as: Custom-tier smallest drill as a figure ('<0.008"')
Custom-tier mask web as a figure ('<0.003"')
note: Sunstone's Custom (quoted) tier as its own profile, so tools that read only the top-level floors see it. The online profile is sunstone_circuits.json. Read 2026-10-23 from the redesigned site (Next.js payload, curl, no LLM); the 2026-10-14 figures in sunstone_circuits.json advanced-o (0.002" track, 0.005" drill, via + 0.006") came from the old main page and are not on the current site. Fit for a 0.50 mm BGA with 0.24 mm pads (0.26 mm channel): one 0.0762 track needs 0.0762 + 2 x 0.0762 = 0.2286 mm. A through via (0.4064 mm outer / 0.5588 mm inner pad) cannot sit between those balls; the published path is a filled microvia in the pad (75 um / 200 um).

stackups_note: The 8, 10 and 12 L standard FR-4 constructions of sunstone_circuits.json (read 2026-10-17 from the construction-sheet PDFs; every sheet is still linked from the layer-stackup page on 2026-10-23). The page: 'ASC Sunstone has published our set of standard multilayer constructions for FR-4 designs'; a custom tier may also quote a custom stack-up. Stackup selector data (89 rows: copper weight 1/2/3 oz finished x layers x thickness) is embedded in the page's Next.js payload, readable with curl (no JS needed); each row links a construction-sheet PDF on cms.sunstone.com. One stackup per unique construction sheet (sheet code, e.g. L04-062-1ozHoz = 1 oz inner / half-oz outer foil; 1oz1oz; 2oz2oz). Every layer thickness is printed in both in and mm; thickness_mm uses the printed mm. copper_outer_oz is the BASE outer foil weight as printed ('0.5 oz foil plated to approximate* thickness 0.0017'); the page's selector calls these 1 / 2 / 3 oz FINISHED weights (site_copper_weight-s). er: 77 sheets print a sheet-level footnote 'Average Dielectric Constant 4.3 @ 1 GHz / 4.8 @ 1 MHz' (er = 4.3 at 1 GHz used on every dielectric); 8 newer sheets print 'Avg Dk 4.5' / 'Avg DC 4.5' / 'Avg Dielectric Constant 4.5' on each dielectric (er = 4.5). Each layer's er-s says which. The page says these are FR-4 constructions; no laminate brand. None is stated as impedance-controlled. Site data issues: the '2 Oz' 6-layer rows (all 7 thicknesses) link to L06-xxx-1ozHoz sheets identical in numbers to the '1 Oz' ones (sheets with Avg Dk 4.5 instead of the 4.3 footnote) - so no 6-layer 1oz/1oz sheet is published. For the 7 L06-xxx-1ozHoz codes the newer variant (per-layer Avg Dk 4.5, correct printed total) is used; the older variant linked from the '1 Oz' rows has identical layer thicknesses but prints the 4.3 @ 1 GHz footnote and a total short by 0.0014 in (e.g. 0.0608 vs 0.0622). '1 Oz' 8L 0.093 has a duplicate row linking the 8L 0.078 sheet; '1 Oz' 4L 0.078 and '2 Oz' 10L 0.093 rows are duplicated; '1 Oz' 4L 0.093 has no PDF or image (not published); '3 Oz' 4L 0.093 links the 4L 0.039 2oz2oz PDF, so L04-093-2oz2oz was transcribed from its stackup image (it prints two unclad cores with a 2x2116 prepreg between them, as printed). Typos copied as printed (e.g. '1x180'). The example PDF URL under /docs/default-source/layer-stack-up-2022/ returned 404 (superseded by the cms.sunstone.com set). The sheets' own printed totals disagree with the sum of their printed layers on these (measured_total_mm = sum of layers; printed_total-s = sheet's total): L04-125-1ozHoz: sum 3.1448 vs printed 3.1598; L08-047-1ozHoz: sum 1.2398 vs printed 1.1684; L08-062-1ozHoz: sum 1.5346 vs printed 1.4630; L08-093-1ozHoz: sum 2.4436 vs printed 2.3724; L08-125-1ozHoz: sum 3.1856 vs printed 3.1140; L10-062-1ozHoz: sum 1.5906 vs printed 1.5189; L10-125-1ozHoz: sum 3.2058 vs printed 3.1344; L12-078-1ozHoz: sum 2.0530 vs printed 1.9380; L14-093-1ozHoz: sum 2.4138 vs printed 2.3419; L14-125-1ozHoz: sum 3.2266 vs printed 3.1547; L16-125-1ozHoz: sum 3.1810 vs printed 3.1090; L18-125-1ozHoz: sum 3.1862 vs printed 3.1140. Left out (a dielectric without thickness or Dk on the sheet): 4 Layer StackUp (0.093") L04-093-2oz2oz. Order: klayout reads the first 8 and takes the first of a layer count, so the 0.062 in 0.5 oz-outer / 1 oz-inner build of 4 / 6 / 8 / 10 layers and the thinnest 12 / 14 / 16 / 18-layer builds come first.
